snippet.title: Dragon's Lair II: Time Warp for Playstation 3 (First Boot Gameplay)
snippet.description:
Do it, for the children!

So for Dragon's Lair II, they actually went for a more focused storyline that removed most of the random elements of the original game, so this is very much more of a consistent learning experience. They also didn't use Daphne as a reward for someone to see at the end of the game and as long as you beat the first section, you saw her, so that's a nice chance of pace.

However, this also lends to hearing the same dialogue over and over and over again...and if you suck at something, you always have to earn your back right back by doing the same motions.

Clearly, I didn't get good at this at all.


2017-09-03 13:51:12
